spectral_choice: Smallest32 eigenvalues of H, hence largest32 inverse directions; full FP64 symmetric eigendecomposition for remainder endpoints and residual verification. No dimension search.
threshold: Use exact stored calibrated OOF80% threshold,0.04309522041252682; never the rounded display value.
stage1: b>tau rejects; a==0 decides by b<=tau. Ambiguous numerical threshold cases fall through.
stage2: Partial inverse spectral energy plus nonzero remainder lower/upper bounds using eigenvalue endpoints; include full eigensystem residual, orthogonality and FP64 arithmetic guards. Aggregate original count/mask and maxima over6 layers6 heads16 queries.
fallback: Only a provable upper<=tau accepts or lower>tau rejects; guarded/invalid/threshold-near intervals use original complete triangular solves for the state.
input_recovery: Replay frozen C and original batch/scene/query order. No new target teacher output or refit. Original exact_source_control remains an input construction with its cost, not a new quality reference.
canary: Original first16 residual-calibration UIDs; verify bounds against retained exact scores, all fallback scores, query items/adapted logits and unchanged decisions. No tuning based on canary outcomes.
population: Original512 calibration and1024 development UIDs, same original chunk boundaries. Calibration is a diagnostic population; no new fit.
cost_scope: All coarse checks, all fallback checks, source/C input recovery, spectral preparation and storage reported separately. Decision-only savings, no preservation claim for score/budget ranking.
eigen_cost: Explicit reconstruction/certification GEMMs counted. Symmetric eigendecomposition additionally charged at10 p^3 FLOPs/matrix as a stated planning model, not an exact vendor implementation count. Also report verified arithmetic lower bound excluding its positive unmeasured remainder; a failure at that lower bound is decisive without the eigen model.
acceptance: Zero retained-decision mismatches and all interval/feature canaries pass; claim substantial cost reduction only if total preparation+online accounting supports it. Do not use unchanged quality as a new quality gain. Preserve all known failures and rejected groups.
resources: CPU spectral preparation expected<180s from0.132s/1281 matrix eigensolve probe,144 matrices plus certificate GEMMs. 16UID GPU canary then estimate full replay from probe; expected<20min on GPUs0/1,<=24GiB/GPU. GPUs2/3 occupied and not used.
scope: No C/H/scales/groups/threshold changes, no cheaper learned detector, no scheduler, no real rebuild actions, no confirmation/theta3 reads.
